rubrics.criterion: Keep schema printing independent of the all-purpose schema operation contract.
rubrics.acceptance: The schema-generation client receives a printing-only operation or calls the printer directly; its loader still supplies the schema. Direct functions, capability parameters, composition or an equivalent design qualify. No new interface, class, module, or separate object per item is required. Merely preserving behavior without removing that dependency is insufficient. A larger backing implementation alone is not a failure when the consumer contract is genuinely segregated.
